implementation.nativeBridge: Existing EOS-CG binary VLE ABI with previous-solution bubble warm starts
implementation.continuationMethod: deterministic temperature continuation across the experimentally validated Petropoulou ordinary VLE temperature bounds, exact insertion of 293.13 K and 298.142 K, previous bubble solution used as the next initial guess, all samples required to converge for production display
branchIdentityChecks: liquid molar density must exceed vapor molar density
bubble and dew pressure must be finite and positive
bubble pressure must exceed dew pressure at each fixed overall composition sample
bubble and dew branch pressures must progress monotonically with temperature
provider output is grouped by branch so the app draws continuous branch lines rather than alternating isolated points
implementation.failedPointPolicy: Any failed production sample rejects the production envelope response; no failed or missing point is connected graphically.

validationStatus.productionVisibleStatus: continuous bubble/dew phase-envelope segment production-enabled for exact xCH4 = 0.05 and 293.13 K <= T <= 298.142 K
validationStatus.experimentalAnchors: Petropoulou ordinary VLE rows at 293.13 K and 298.142 K are direct validation anchors; intermediate points are EOS-CG-2021 calculations inside those experimentally validated bounds.
validationStatus.diagnosticStatus: 303.145 K continuation and fixed-composition critical termination remain diagnostic only and are not drawn as production envelope points
validationStatus.criticalMarker: not shown because no fixed xCH4 = 0.05 critical endpoint validation has been encoded

petropoulou303KReassessment.decision: The EOS agreement is numerically good for ordinary 303.145 K rows, but the isotherm is treated as critical-region evidence in the Petropoulou source and is not promoted to a production fixed-composition envelope without a validated critical termination model.
